title: Three-dimensional Cell Culture Model for Measuring the Effects of Interstitial Fluid Flow on Tumor Cell Invasion
protocol: Thaw a small aliquot of Matrigel on ice at 4 °C.
Prepare a final volume of gel recipe according to the specified concentrations.
Mix 10x PBS with sterile water and 1N sodium hydroxide as per the table instructions.
Add Matrigel to achieve a concentration of 1 mg/ml in the total solution.
Add rat tail type I collagen to achieve a concentration of 1.3 mg/ml in the total solution.
Incubate the final mixed gel solution for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Place 12 mm diameter 8 μm pore cell culture inserts into a 12-well plate using sterilized forceps.
Count cells and resuspend them in serum-free media to achieve a concentration of 5 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Add 100 μl of the cell suspension to 900 μl of gel solution.
Mix the final mixture thoroughly by gentle pipetting up and down.
Add 150 μl of the final mixture to each insert.
Transfer the insert to a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 30 minutes until gel polymerizes.
Add 100 μl of serum-free media on top of the gel and 1200 μl under the insert for the STATIC condition.
Add 100 μl of serum-free media under the insert and 650 μl above the gel for the FLOW condition.
Avoid any air bubbles beneath the insert during addition of media.
Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 24 hours.
Add 500 μl of 1X PBS per well into a new 24-well plate to wash the inserts.
Remove the medium remaining in the upper portion of the flow transwells and determine its volume.
Calculate total eluted volume by subtracting the remaining volume from the initial 650 μl for flow rate calculations.
Use cotton swabs to remove gel from the inserts and wipe the top surface of the membrane to remove non-invaded cells.
Place the inserts into the 24-well plate containing 1X PBS for 15 seconds to wash the inserts.
Remove PBS and add 500 μl of 4% paraformaldehyde underneath each insert.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature to fix the transmigrated cells.
Remove the PFA and rinse once with 500 μl 1X PBS.
Add 500 μl of 0.5% Triton X-100 solution beneath the inserts.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature to permeabilize the cells.
Cut membranes out of the insert using a razor blade.
Place the cut membranes into 100 μl of 2 μg/ml DAPI in 1X PBS solution with the underside of the membrane face down.
Wrap the plate in aluminum foil and place on a shaker at 150 rpm for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash membranes in 500 μl 1X PBS on shaker (repeat 3 times for 10 minutes each) to remove free DAPI.
Place membranes on glass slides with transmigrated cells facing up.
Add mounting solution and cover slip.
Calculate the average flow rate by dividing the total eluted volume in the flow condition by the incubation time.
Calculate the average flow velocity by dividing the average flow rate by the cross-sectional area of the gel/membrane.

Embed MDA-MB-435S metastatic melanoma cells in a matrix composed of 1.3 mg/ml rat tail tendon collagen type I and 1 mg/ml Matrigel basement membrane matrix at a final cell concentration of 5 x 10^5 cells/ml.
Compare two conditions: an average interstitial flow of 0.1 μm s-1 and a static condition with no measurable flow rate.
Stain cells with DAPI after 24 hours to facilitate cell counting.
Visualize DAPI-stained nuclei for cell counting using fluorescence microscopy.
Optional: Visualize the cell body using phalloidin stained F-actin structures.
